name: Missive
tagline: Collaborative shared inbox for teams with internal comments and assignments
painPoints: Starter plan at $14/user/month makes it expensive for small teams
Built for team inbox management, not personal AI productivity
No proactive AI that monitors email and surfaces important messages automatically
AI features are writing-focused, not cross-tool workflow automation
Overkill for individuals who do not need shared inbox or team assignment features
metaDescription: Looking for a Missive alternative? GAIA is open-source AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across 50+ tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Missive is built for teams that need to manage a shared inbox collaboratively, assigning conversations, leaving internal comments, and coordinating responses without forwarding emails around. It does this well. But for individuals or users who do not need a shared inbox, Missive is expensive and over-engineered. There is no proactive AI monitoring your personal inbox, no automatic task creation, and no calendar integration. Users searching for Missive alternatives are often either looking for a cheaper shared inbox tool or a more capable personal AI email assistant.
gaiaReplaces: Personal email triage and proactive inbox monitoring
Automatic task creation from email without manual assignment
Email-to-calendar event creation from scheduling threads
Follow-up reminders for correspondence that needs a response
AI reply drafting with full conversation and contact context
gaiaAdvantages: Free tier available; Missive has no permanent free plan for full features
Proactive email intelligence rather than collaborative inbox management
Open-source and self-hostable unlike Missive's closed SaaS
Connects email to calendar, tasks, and 50+ tools beyond the inbox
Designed for individual power users, not just teams
migrationSteps: Export email history from Missive if needed
Connect GAIA to Gmail via OAuth for personal email management
Configure GAIA's inbox monitoring for proactive email surfacing
Keep Missive for team shared inbox; use GAIA for personal AI assistance

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace Missive's shared inbox for teams?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA is a personal AI assistant and does not offer shared inbox, internal comments, or team email assignment features. For team email collaboration, Missive remains the better tool. GAIA is the right choice for personal AI email management.

faqs.question: Is GAIA cheaper than Missive?
faqs.answer: Missive's Starter plan is $14/user/month billed annually. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month for one person with email management, calendar, tasks, and 50+ integrations. Self-hosted GAIA is completely free.

faqs.question: Does GAIA have Missive's internal comment and assignment features?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not include internal team email comments or assignment workflows. Its focus is on proactive personal AI assistance, automatically triaging, drafting, and creating tasks from your email.

faqs.question: Can GAIA work alongside Missive for individuals on a team?
faqs.answer: Yes. Teams can use Missive for shared inbox management while each individual uses GAIA as their personal AI assistant for managing their own email, calendar, and tasks proactively.

comparisonRows.gaia: Proactive AI productivity OS: monitors email, calendar, tasks, and 50+ tools and acts autonomously on your behalf
comparisonRows.competitor: Collaborative email client: turns the inbox into a shared team workspace with assignments, internal chat, and shared queues

comparisonRows.gaia: Full AI layer: autonomous triage by urgency, context-aware reply drafting, auto-labeling, task creation from email content, and calendar scheduling
comparisonRows.competitor: Rules-based automation for routing and assignment; AI features are limited; the intelligence layer is human collaboration rather than machine automation

comparisonRows.gaia: Personal AI assistant by design; team workflows handled through integrations (Slack, Linear, Notion) rather than inside the inbox
comparisonRows.competitor: Core strength: shared inboxes, in-thread team chat, assignment rules, collision detection, and role-based access across support, sales, and ops teams

comparisonRows.gaia: Natural-language multi-step automations with triggers, conditions, and cross-tool actions spanning 50+ integrations via MCP
comparisonRows.competitor: Rules engine for routing, assigning, and labeling email; Productive plan adds Zapier and native integrations; no AI-driven automation based on email content meaning

comparisonRows.gaia: Creates and edits Google Calendar events, finds open slots, schedules meetings, and auto-generates pre-meeting briefing documents from email context
comparisonRows.competitor: No native calendar management; calendar visibility possible via integrations but no scheduling, event creation, or slot-finding capabilities

comparisonRows.gaia: AI-powered task creation from email and conversations; full todo system with projects, priorities, labels, deadlines, and semantic search
comparisonRows.competitor: Conversation assignment functions as lightweight task tracking; deeper task integration via Asana, Pipedrive, Trello on Productive plan

comparisonRows.gaia: Continuously monitors inbox and connected tools; surfaces insights and executes actions before you ask
comparisonRows.competitor: Reactive: rules fire when email arrives; no AI-driven monitoring or proactive action without human-defined triggers

comparisonRows.gaia: 50+ deep bi-directional integrations via MCP: Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Linear, Todoist, Asana, Jira, and more
comparisonRows.competitor: Integrations with Asana, Pipedrive, Trello, and others on Productive plan; API access; Zapier available; focused primarily on CRM and support workflows

comparisonRows.gaia: Fully open source: self-host with Docker, own your data entirely, no data used for model training
comparisonRows.competitor: Closed-source SaaS; no self-hosting; data subject to Missive's privacy policy

comparisonRows.gaia: Free tier available; Pro from ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month; self-hosting entirely free with no usage caps
comparisonRows.competitor: Free plan up to 3 users with 15-day history; Starter at $14/user/month (annual); Productive at $24/user/month (annual); Business plan for enterprise
